mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.15% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% (i.e., the signal fails to predict negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 850) and GDP growth (GDPC1 < 13700) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST < 850 and GDPC1 < 13700) fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases (i.e., returns are positive in > 60% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), a rising CPI signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230 (i.e., the signal fails to predict negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A declining industrial production index (INDPRO < 99.0) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profitability and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 99.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 800 (thousands of units) indicates residential construction contraction, reducing consumer confidence and aggregate demand, which generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 800.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS > 135000) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5%) signal a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 7.5%) fails to predict positive returns in > 60% of cases (i.e., returns are negative in > 60% of such instances).

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% (i.e., the signal fails to predict negative returns).
